They follow your message: one when it is sent, two when it reached their phone, three when it was read. Hollow: it waits for a route. Red: it failed, tap the dots to send it again. An open lock before the time: sent without encryption.

how well your route hides you right now. Grey with a check: as you chose. Yellow: fewer hops for a while. Red: sent directly. Tap it to see why.
